ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is created as part of CR-020. This describes, Product of Interest, Zip Code, Number of Employees should be populated to check Assign Lead Check box for If user role is Inbound rep or Inbound Manager.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR($UserRole.Name = 'Inbound Rep', $UserRole.Name = 'Inbound Manager'), OR(ISBLANK(NumberOfEmployees), ISBLANK(PostalCode), INCLUDES(NSP_Product_Interest__c, '')), NSP_Assign_Lead__c = true)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please Populate Products of Interest, No. of Employees, Zip/Postal Code before selecting Assign Lead.
